Hero_Desc_Blanchet:
Blue rose elemental who is an actress in Monatium.
The reason an elemental such as her is able to survive in Monatium is because of her passion and pride in acting.
She wants to overcome her weakness—a deficiency of various emotional expressions—and become an actress beloved by many.
Album_Hate_Blanchet: Only being able to act out sad roles.
Album_Hobby_Blanchet: Organizing scripts, practicing acting alone, taking care of Blue Bird.
Album_Wish_Blanchet: Expressing emotions without making friends feel sad.
Album_Blanchet1: I first met Blanchet in Monatium's theater. I happened to visit and was startled, thinking I had seen a phantom. But it turned out Blanchet wasn't a phantom, but an elemental of blue roses. Her pale complexion and expressionless face really did make her look like a phantom.
Album_Blanchet2: Despite her beauty and talent, Blanchet never lands the lead role. When I asked why, she only gave a faint smile and said nothing. The way she looked so forlorn made it hard to press further.
Album_Blanchet3: Blanchet is raising a Blue Bird. She found it injured and nursed it back to health, but now it refuses to leave her side. Recently, she got it a birdcage, but the bird seems so content in it that it never comes out, which has Blanchet worried.
Album_Blanchet4: I once watched Blanchet practice acting alone. Her emotional performance moved me to tears, and I clapped. Blanchet jumped in shock and shut her mouth tightly. When I asked what was wrong, she said that wasn't supposed to be a sad scene. I clapped for nothing. I should've just stayed quiet...
Album_Blanchet5: Blanchet's theater troupe isn't very popular, so she often takes on understudy roles in other troupes. I happened to visit one such troupe and found everyone in tears. Curious, I asked what kind of performance she did. Blanchet simply waved it off. Even today, Blanchet seems troubled by her naturally sorrowful aura.
Album_Blanchet6: When I asked if she missed Elemental Mountain, she said she sometimes does. Especially when she feels exhausted from acting, she misses Gabia, who would silently stay by her side. I asked if Gabia's quietness ever felt frustrating, but Blanchet said it was actually comforting. It seems she relied on Gabia a lot.
Album_Blanchet7: Recently, Epica has been coaching Blanchet in acting. Epica demonstrates the lines first, and Blanchet tries to follow, but no matter what, it always turns into a sad version, leaving Epica flustered. After some thought, Epica concluded that the problem wasn't her voice or movements, but her facial muscles. She even designed a special training program. Blanchet finds it tough, but she's determined to improve.
LoveHero_Blanchet:
I'll gladly act in your stead,
Master.
LoveHeroCancel_Blanchet:
One can't always
be in the spotlight.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Hate1: As Blanchet elegantly sliced the cutlet, a puff of warm air floated out. She watched this scene in melancholic contemplation for a moment.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Hate2: Blanchet's silent expression while looking at the space food seemed to carry a story. It must not have been easy for an Elemental to live in Monatium.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like1: After placing a single rose on top and taking a photo, Blanchet elegantly scooped a spoonful. It seems to be her unique way of dining.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like2: Enjoying teatime was something that suited Blanchet so well, it was like seeing a painting come to life.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like3: Blanchet commented on the beautiful harmony of different gems put together, saying it's like a well-crafted script that expresses individuality without disrupting the atmosphere.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like4: After hearing it was chocolate cake, Blanchet savored it slowly. The mystical vibe of a Yule Log Cake goes well with her.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like5: When I insisted that the unusual taste would be a valid new experience, Blanchet was enthusiastic about it. Seeing her enduring the sour taste with a tearful expression made me feel guilty.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like6: Blanchet showed interest in the colorful Songpyeon and suggested it would have been better if they tasted different as well.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like7: Reminded of a gift from a fan Blanchet once received, her eyes slightly welled up. Hang in there Blanchet.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like8: She mentioned having been offered to model for a similar product. I realized then how much of a power duo Blanchet and the sparkling powder were.
Food_ChefNote_Blanchet_Like9: I'm envious of the various flavors in the candies! says Blanchet. She vowed to try to bring such diversity to her acting.

LoveLetter_Blanchet: Thanks to you, Master, I have been able to find so many friends within the Order. I have become accustomed to smiling while having fun with others. I still get a bit flustered when you pull my cheeks sometimes... however, I believe such playful behavior is part of your inherent gentle nature. I was reminded of a letter I received from an audience member when I was still an unknown actress. I wasn't used to expressing emotions back then, but I know for certain I was smiling. I wanted to share that feeling with you, Master.
LoveCall_Blanchet:
Ah, Master. This is rather sudden... but there was something I absolutely wanted to tell you, so I called.

Today, as usual, Epica coached me in acting. My role was a protagonist longing for someone.
But when I entered the scene and acted out remembering the person I missed... Epica suddenly became delighted and showered me with praise.
She said my smile looked completely natural and genuinely happy.

I thought back over how I had managed to smile that way and quickly realized the answer.
When I smiled, without even noticing it, I had thought of you, Master.
You are... someone who makes me smile.
It is embarrassing, but I wanted to make sure I told you.

Thank you, Master.
I will work even harder so that I can make you smile too. Hehe.
